Marci's work sits comfortably in small-venue indie circuits and streaming playlists that favor atmospheric, lo-fi-tinged pop.

His work often incorporates ambient and experimental sounds, with lyrics that explore themes of identity, culture, and personal experience. Helado Negro is recognized for his smooth vocals and innovative production techniques that merge traditional Latin music elements with modern electronic styles.
